cards.title: Estuary Watch
cards.purpose: Collect coastal images and send them to Earth.
cards.lesson: A useful image must also reach Earth.
cards.scope_notice: Authored coastal training region; no flood-warning service.
cards.values_source: Read numeric targets from the frozen mission config; never duplicate thresholds in this copy file.

cards.title: Tropical Forest Watch
cards.purpose: Collect images of a tropical forest region and send them to Earth.
cards.lesson: Target access, storage, energy and radio capacity work together.
cards.scope_notice: No real deforestation detection is computed.
cards.values_source: Read numeric targets from the frozen mission config; never duplicate thresholds in this copy file.

cards.title: Polar Ice Survey
cards.purpose: Send complete images from every selected Survey target to Earth.
cards.lesson: Taking an image and delivering the whole image are different.
cards.scope_notice: Regional training scenario; the production Survey evaluator still needs implementation.
cards.values_source: Read numeric targets from the frozen mission config; never duplicate thresholds in this copy file.
cards.scored_requirements: Overall captures and returned MB, plus one fully delivered observation for every selected target. A partly returned image does not complete a target.

cards.title: Communication
cards.purpose: Create test image data and send it during ground contact.
cards.lesson: A fast radio still needs available data, ground contact and energy.
cards.scope_notice: Counts distinct accepted transmission steps returning positive MB. Two steps in one contact window count twice; repeated evidence for one step counts once. No real RF link-budget model.
cards.values_source: Read numeric targets from the frozen mission config; never duplicate thresholds in this copy file.
cards.capture_quota_role: Supplies test data and limits captures. Meeting the capture quota is not an extra success condition.
cards.scored_requirements: Required successful transmission steps and returned MB.

cards.title: Weather Monitoring
cards.purpose: Observe the same region on different orbits and return data.
cards.lesson: Repeat visits need a suitable operation plan.
cards.scope_notice: Accepted captures on distinct revolutions plus total returned MB. Each visit image does not need complete delivery. Repeat observation only; no forecast, live feed or atmospheric sensor model.
cards.values_source: Read numeric targets from the frozen mission config; never duplicate thresholds in this copy file.
cards.capture_quota_role: Limits captures. Success uses qualifying different-revolution visits and returned MB, without an extra capture-quota target.
cards.scored_requirements: Required distinct selected-region revolution visits and returned MB.

messages.new_mission_unavailable: This mission is waiting for simulator confirmation and integration. It cannot launch yet.
messages.saved_a: Design A is saved for comparison. Running B keeps A unchanged.
messages.b_locked_setup: Keep the mission, orbit, launcher and launch profile the same. Change spacecraft parts for Design B.
messages.session_storage: Saved runs are kept in this session. Refreshing or starting a new mission can clear them.
messages.stale_review: Your design changed. Review it again before launch.
messages.operations_explanation: The same requested operating plan may lead to different accepted actions because the hardware changed. Changing the requested plan is Design + operations.
messages.missing_evidence: The required run evidence is missing. A score cannot be calculated.

part_explanations.instrument: Controls the data created by an observation. A heavier instrument may exceed your selected launch profile.
part_explanations.radio: Changes how quickly stored data can be sent during ground contact. A faster radio still needs power and data to send.
part_explanations.storage: Holds captured data until it is sent. More space alone does not return data to Earth.
part_explanations.battery: Stores energy for actions when generation is insufficient. Check the actual energy trace.
part_explanations.solar: Produces energy under this simplified scenario. More generation does not create target or contact opportunities.
part_explanations.bus: Adds spacecraft structure and baseline demand. Include it once in mass and cost.
part_explanations.launcher_profile: The selected launcher and profile set independent compatibility and mass limits. Use the actual validator reason; passing mass alone does not approve launch.

source_policy: All component figures, credits, windows and goal rules here are illustrative gameplay assumptions. Preserve the existing source ledger/profile-specific credit. This copy supplies no new NASA-verified measurements.

weather_rule.meaning: Accepted captures of the selected region on distinct revolutions, plus the required total returned MB. Complete delivery of each visit image is not required.
weather_rule.evidence_status: Rule agreed by non-HPC owners; HPC must confirm accepted-event timing and revolution mapping.
